summary: A panel of checkboxes that shows each of the four element kinds with its count, lets the user hide or show each kind, and offers a colour-by-kind option.
purpose: Lets the viewer declutter the 3D scene by hiding some kinds of element.
why: Likely reason: the scene can hold many elements, so the viewer needs filters. The schedule-only count is shown so the viewer knows about work with no 3D shape.
how: It counts the components for each kind, shows a checkbox per kind, shows the schedule-only count, and passes changes back to the parent screen.
inputs: The list of components, the set of hidden kinds, the toggle action, the colour setting and its change action, and the checklist count.
outputs: A list of checkboxes with counts, a schedule-only line, and a colour checkbox. It does not change data itself.
risks: The counts are recalculated only when the component list changes, so a stale list shows stale counts.
debug: If a count looks wrong, check the component list passed in. If a box does not hide anything, check that the parent screen uses the hidden set.
